name: hanyu-pinyin-extension
description: Chrome and Edge extension that annotates Chinese text with Hanyu Pinyin.

scripts.run:chrome: npm run build && node scripts/run-extension.mjs --browser chrome --dist dist --profile .browser-profile/chrome
scripts.run:edge: npm run build && node scripts/run-extension.mjs --browser edge --dist dist --profile .browser-profile/edge
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm test && npm run build && npm run store:validate
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run store:validate && node scripts/package-release.mjs
